|lore=Stormtroopers are trained to stun, not kill, priority targets in order to split enemy forces and hold the leaders for interrogation. Stun effects wear off, requiring efficient action.
|game_text=If a battle was just initiated at an interior site, use 1 Force to exclude from that battle all characters of ability > 2 and all leaders (on both sides).

|combos=* [[Stunning Leader]] + Cloud City sites + Lift Tubes A great point defense system that'll allow you to spread a bit thinner than normal and still be able to bring all your low ability characters to brawl in a mainless battle.<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json swccg-card-json Dark.json], Stunning Leader (GEMP ID 2_140, commit d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab), records the four strategy recommendations and both later rulings on additional arrivals and a required target. These are attributed recommendations and rulings, not a transcription of the original face or a guarantee of every tactical outcome. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20260422134639/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf 2023 Advanced Rulebook], p. 129, gives the later "for remainder of battle" wording. Decipher's [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Glossary Version 2.0] (November 1998), p. 126, clarifies exclusion from the battle but does not contain that explicit duration phrase. Original-era applicability of the later-arrival ruling is not established by this citation. Preserved data copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183206/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Internet Archive] (20 October 2026). Lookup: [https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Stunning%20Leader Scomp: Stunning Leader].</ref>
* [[Stunning Leader]] + Ability > 2 Imperials + Stormtroopers + [[Trooper Assault]] This is awesome because you get a speed gain and a defensive gain; the Stormtroopers deploy for free and [[Stunning Leader]] excludes the high ability Imperial, leaving only totally immune troopers in the fight. Add a [[Comlink]] for more fun.
* [[Stunning Leader]] + Cloud City Troopers + Imperial Trooper Guards + E-3P0 Bring out the odds cards! With this kind of Cloud City defense force, you could have a blast with Light Side Mains. Trooper Assaults would make the power here obscene. Don't forget the [[E Chu Ta]] for maximum insult to injury.
* [[Stunning Leader]] + IT-0 + [[IG-88]] + [[Probe Droid]] How about a droid strike team? Exclude all their mains and send your droids on suicide missions. Retrieve with the [[Cloud City: Incinerator (Dark){{!}}Cloud City: Incinerator]] and repeat ad infinitum. With a spy on the team, it can't be kept out of the action.
